headline: Leverkusen's 5 straight wins meet a Hoffenheim side that won in January
summary: Bayer Leverkusen arrive at Hoffenheim on 5 straight wins, and the chances are flowing: 2.63 expected goals a game. Hoffenheim are 14th with 6 points, and they had lost 4 straight before Sunday's win at Gladbach. Yet they beat Leverkusen 1-0 here in January, which is why the market makes Leverkusen only narrow favourites — 41.6% against 34.6%. The home side's last 2 games both ended 2-3, so the total is 3.5 goals, with over at 48.6%. It reads as a close game with goals in it.
read: Leverkusen are the form side of this fixture — five wins in a row, 14 goals scored and 2.63 xG a game — and are 41.6% favourites. But the market keeps it close: Hoffenheim won this fixture 1-0 in January and the handicap rates Leverkusen only about a sixth of a goal better, with the total set high at 3.5 goals.

facts.fact: Leverkusen have won their last five matches in all competitions, scoring 14 goals and conceding four.
facts.meaning: They arrive in the best run of anyone in this fixture, having also won 2-0 at home to RB Leipzig and 4-3 at Mainz in the league.

facts.fact: The market makes Leverkusen 41.6% to win at Hoffenheim, with the home side at 34.6% and the draw at 23.9%.
facts.meaning: Leverkusen are favourites but only narrowly — this is priced close to a coin-flip between the two teams rather than a top-four side against a bottom-half one.

facts.fact: Hoffenheim have won one of their last five, losing the other four (WLLLL), conceding 12 goals in the process.
facts.meaning: Their only win in that run was Sunday's 2-1 at Borussia Mönchengladbach; before that came defeats to Beşiktaş, Hamburg, Paderborn and OFI.

facts.fact: Hoffenheim beat Leverkusen 1-0 in this fixture last January.
facts.meaning: They also won the meeting in Leverkusen earlier in 2025, so the recent head-to-head record runs against the visitors.

facts.fact: Hoffenheim are 14th in the Bundesliga with six points from six games; Leverkusen are 4th with 13.
facts.meaning: Ten places and seven points separate them after six rounds, with Leverkusen level on points with third-placed Freiburg.

facts.fact: Hoffenheim have lost their last two home games by the same 2-3 scoreline, to Hamburg in the league and to Beşiktaş in the Europa League.
facts.meaning: They score at home but concede more — both games were open, and both slipped away.

facts.fact: Leverkusen have averaged 2.63 expected goals per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They are not just winning, they are creating chances worth close to three goals a game, including 5.22 xG in the 4-0 win at Lech Poznan.

facts.fact: The market's main total is 3.5 goals, with Over priced at 48.6%.
facts.meaning: A high-scoring game is expected — the line is a full goal above the usual 2.5 — though Under 3.5 is still narrowly the more likely outcome at 51.4%.

sources.fact: French outlet Olympique-et-Lyonnais reports that Hoffenheim were without Nathan De Cat, Patrick Wimmer and Albian Hajdari for their Europa League match against Lyon.
Hoffenheim won 2-1 away at Borussia Mönchengladbach on Sunday, a sixth straight league defeat for the bottom-placed hosts.
Hoffenheim sit 14th in the Bundesliga table ahead of the match against fourth-placed Leverkusen.
Bild reports that Hoffenheim mocked Leverkusen's former striker Stefan Kießling with a banner, 13 years after the 'phantom goal'.
After a shock opening defeat to promoted Elversberg, Leverkusen have taken 13 of a possible 18 points and sit fourth, level on points with third-placed Freiburg.
Yahoo Sports reports that Leverkusen go into their Europa League game at OFI on a five-game winning run in all competitions.
Victor Boniface has been left out of Leverkusen's squad for the Europa League trip to Greece, with the report noting his long-term knee injury from January 2026.
Leverkusen currently sit fourth in the Bundesliga table ahead of their trip to 14th-placed Hoffenheim.
